InterpolatedStringStart.Definition: Marks the beginning of an interpolated string.

InterpolatedStringText.Definition: The literal text inside of an interpolated string.

InterpolatedStringEnd.Definition: Marks the end of an interpolated string.

InterpolatedVerbatimStringStart.Definition: Marks the beginning of an interpolated verbatim string.

NumericFormatSpecifier.Definition: A format pattern used inside an interpolated string that defines how a numeric value should be converted to text.
